title: Liverpool and Nottingham Forest clash in English Championship
seoTitle: Liverpool vs Nottingham Forest: Premier League Preview
subtitle: Saturday's match sees both teams seeking their first win in the competition
excerpt: Get all the details on the Liverpool vs Nottingham Forest Premier League clash, including where to watch, absences, and predicted lineups.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Saturday morning at 8:30 a.m. (Brasilia time), Liverpool will host Nottingham Forest at Anfield for the second round of the English Championship. Both teams enter the field seeking their first victory in the competition after stumbling in the opening round.

Where to watch the match

Live broadcast of the clash between Liverpool and Nottingham Forest begins at 8:30 a.m. (Brasilia time). Fans can follow the match on the Cazé TV and Disney+ channels.

Teams' standing in the competition

In the opening round, Liverpool drew 2-2 against Newcastle away from home. Meanwhile, Nottingham Forest played in front of their home crowd but were defeated by Leeds 1-0.

Absences and Liverpool's predicted lineup

Liverpool faces significant absences for the match, including right-back Conor Bradley. Ekitike and Leoni are still recovering from knee injuries, while Joe Gomez is recovering from a muscle issue. Consequently, manager Andoni Iraola is expected to field the team with Alisson; Frimpong, Jacquet, Van Dijk, and Kerkez; Szoboszlai and Gravenberch; Ngumoha, Wirtz, and Gakpo; Isak.

Physical issues at Nottingham Forest

Nottingham Forest is also dealing with absences and key doubts. Top scorer Chris Wood is suffering from muscle pain and is a doubt; he may start on the bench or be replaced by Igor Jesus. Neco Williams also has a chance of missing out, opening space for Brazilian Jair in a likely back-three formation. Additionally, the club awaits a decision on Morgan Gibbs-White, who reported a muscle problem and was spared from intense training.

Nottingham Forest's predicted lineup

If the options expected by Oliver Glasner's coaching staff are confirmed, Nottingham Forest should start the match with Sels; Jair, Milenkovic, and Murillo; Aina, McAtee, Sangare, Netz; Gibbs-White and Ndoye; Igor Jesus.

With information from Terra.
